title: A row of a query table does not filter the model column it was built from
query: EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS ( Colors, "Color", Colors[Color], "Sales Amount", [Sales Amount] )

source.quote: The syntax after TABLE defines a query table, which has a data lineage and it is populated in an empty filter context before the query is executed.
source.supports: the query table has a lineage of its own; the example on the page needs TREATAS to filter Product[Color] with it

derivation: The measure does a context transition on the row of Colors, which filters Colors[Color]. Colors has no relationship with Sales, so the measure is the total 540 in each row.
alternative: If the query table kept the lineage of Product[Color], the context transition would filter Product: Red 460, Blue 80, Green BLANK.
